name: ThumbGate Pro Constraints
description: Public Pro upgrade bundle installed by `thumbgate pro --upgrade` for local workflow hardening.

constraints.rule: Do not claim done, fixed, shipped, published, or paid until the relevant command, URL, PR, workflow, or billing record has been checked.
Before editing existing code, read the surrounding implementation and tests so the patch follows local contracts.
Block destructive git operations such as reset --hard, checkout --, clean -fd, and force-push unless the operator explicitly requested that exact operation.
Block production database writes, deletes, migrations, and irreversible data operations unless a backup, target environment, and rollback plan are present.
Never print, commit, paste, or persist secrets. Use only sanitized status output when verifying credentials.
Before saying a code change is ready, run the narrow relevant tests or explain exactly why verification could not run.
Do not describe views, clicks, stars, configured gates, or generated artifacts as revenue, customers, or proven interventions.
Before promoting a paid offer, verify the landing page and checkout route return HTTP 200 and point to the intended Stripe path.
Commercial claims must match docs/COMMERCIAL_TRUTH.md for pricing, traction, tier limits, and proof language.
Long-running agent work must have a bounded objective, progress evidence, and a stop condition instead of open-ended activity.
